# CANDIDATE: SKEW_VVIX_TAIL_RISK_FADE

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The skew_vvix_tail_risk_fade trigger aims to capture extreme put skew and VVIX mean-reversion events, where elevated VVIX (volatility of VIX) and extreme SPY put skew indicate overpriced tail risk, prompting a fade (selling puts) as volatility mean-reverts. This edge exists because market makers overcharge for tail protection during volatility spikes, creating a systematic short-volatility premium capture opportunity when VVIX reverts to its mean.

## Mechanism

Entry: Trigger fires when (1) SPY 25-delta put skew > 2.0 standard deviations above its 20-day mean AND (2) VVIX > 1.5 standard deviations above its 20-day mean. Exit: Close position at 50% premium profit target or 7% catastrophic stop (whichever comes first), with a time stop at 15:50 ET. Uses ITM-2 SPY 0DTE puts for maximum gamma exposure on mean-reversion moves.
